title: Swords Dash
description: Two configurable sword combat mechanics: a charged dash and a reaction fall-dodge with ground slam
body:
# Swords Dash

Adds two configurable combat mechanics to spice up sword combat.

## ⚔️ Sword Dash
Hold to charge your sword, then release to dash forward with a sweeping
attack. Works both as a normal ground dash and as an air dash while jumping.

![Wood sword dash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Frbixr5j/images/8232abf2c6c77241a8cf603715b465d1035a02b3.gif)

![Wood sword air dash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Frbixr5j/images/fca77df65259eee3b638b0be932b6b7bb52303f8.gif)

The better your sword's material, the stronger and longer the dash — a
netherite blade launches you much further than a wooden one.

![Netherite air dash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Frbixr5j/images/05d2689dbb0ffde7f51691f5778d2d92a98a824f.gif)

## 🛡️ Fall Dodge
Press **Shift within the last 3 blocks** before landing to dodge part of
the fall damage. It's a reaction — react too early and it won't work.

![Fall dodge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Frbixr5j/images/001fe29fd621dc839fa95610e37554ce4cb73af3.gif)

## 💥 Ground Slam
A successful dodge unleashes a shockwave on landing that damages and
knocks back nearby enemies. The bigger the fall, the stronger the wave.

![Ground slam vs zombies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Frbixr5j/images/fab2da214c192c27252c153df3a1607a7796dfd1.gif)

## ⚙️ Activation & Config
Right-click or a custom keybind (default **R**).
Fully configurable via **Mod Menu + Cloth Config**.

## 📦 Dependencies
- Fabric API (required)
- Cloth Config API (required)
- Mod Menu (optional)
